text:
elaine_cs: :rotating_light: ACME reporting failures after a KMS rotation. They see 401s for encrypted inference calls and an audit-log gap from ~2026-03-16T03:45:00Z to 03:52:00Z. Customer requests CVE status, ETA for patch, and mitigation steps. Raising to incidents — attaching quick repro and logs.

kyle_support: Thanks. Do we know if this is caused by a key rotation job or a rollout to the KMS client? Any repro steps?

elaine_cs: Repro (from customer's env):
```
curl -v -H "Authorization: Bearer <token>" \
  -H "x-redwood-customer-kid: projects/acme/keys/ai-key-2026" \
  https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate
* HTTP/2 401
* {"error":"kms: key unavailable during handshake"}
```
They also pasted audit tail showing missing writes: `audit.write` entries jump from seq 112345 -> 112392.

anika_eng: I pulled the handshake path — looks like a race when key metadata is temporarily GC'd during async rotation. Quick mitigation: enable fallback KMS key routing and disable async rotation for affected customers. You can flip the flag on dedicated/private with: 
```
# toggle fallback routing
rdwctl config set KMS_FALLBACK_ROUTING=true --customer acme
rdwctl config set KMS_ASYNC_ROTATION=false --customer acme
```
This prevents the transient key-deletion path.

jonathan_sre: Observability note — querying stackdriver/audit shows the gap. Use this to enumerate affected requests: 
```
resource.type="redwood_api" AND protoPayload.methodName="GenerateToken" AND timestamp>"2026-03-16T03:40:00Z" AND timestamp<"2026-03-16T04:00:00Z"
```
Also looking at infra logs: several KMS handshake timeouts at 03:46:02-03:46:10 UTC.

security_oncall: Assigned CVE-2026-12345 for the rotation race condition (moderate-high). Priority P0 for customers with retention/compliance SLAs. Triage: hotfix required and backport to 1.4.x branch. Preliminary timeline: build + staging canary in 12h, production rollout (canary -> 15% -> 100%) within 36-48h if no regressions. Immediate mitigations: fallback key routing + manual key pinning for private deployments (HSM-only). For customers who need legal attestation we will provide an interim incident statement.

deploy-bot: Deploy job started: staging v1.4.5-patch1 (build 987). Running integration smoke.

anika_eng: Patch notes (high-level): add atomic key-handle pin during rotation, buffer audit writes to WAL until KMS handshake completes, add metrics for rotation failures. Also will include a rehydrate tool for missing audit entries (reads WAL and S3 export).

kyle_support: I told ACME about the temporary workaround (fallback routing) and offered a 10% credit while we resolve. They asked if logs can be recovered and for a firm ETA by EOD.

security_oncall: Recovery: we can attempt best-effort rehydration of missing audit events from the write-ahead logs if the S3 exports are intact. Estimated recovery 5-7 business days depending on size and legal hold. If customer flags this as compliance-critical, we bump recovery priority.

elaine_cs: Customer legal labelled this P0 due to retention SLA. They want a timeline and a signed note by EOD.

jonathan_sre: Starting a 4-hour incident war room to coordinate patch + recovery. Paging oncall-eng now. We'll centralize artifacts in the incident doc.

deploy-bot: Canary to production started: 3% traffic (v1.4.5-patch1). Current metrics: success 99.5%, error-rate down from 4.2% -> 0.7% for canary cohort. Latency stable.

anika_eng: If canary stays green for 2 hours, we push to 15% then full. I opened PR for the fix: https://github.com/redwood-inference/serving/pull/2345 — includes migration script for audit rehydration.

kyle_support: Drafting customer update now with the mitigation steps and the timeline (canary in 12h, prod within 48h, audit rehydration 5-7 days). Will send in ~45m. :hourglass_flowing_sand:

security_oncall: We'll prepare an interim statement and CVE advisory. Notify legal and compliance. Keep me in the loop for any customer escalation to SOC/assurance.

elaine_cs: Thanks team — I'll keep ACME updated and paste the legal note once ready.
